record.question: Under F.R. 17(1), if an officer ceases to discharge the duties of a post, his entitlement to the pay and allowances attached to that tenure:
options: ceases as soon as he ceases to discharge those duties.
continues until a formal relieving order is entered in the service book.
continues until another officer assumes charge.
continues till the end of the month unless leave is sanctioned.
